arguments.message:
Hi there! To see if the 20‑minute slowdown was a platform‑wide issue, start by checking Meridian’s status page for the time window you experienced the delay. The status page logs every incident – even brief ones – with exact start and end times, so you can see if a platform‑wide degradation was recorded.

If you don’t find any incident covering that period, the slowdown was probably local to your environment (e.g., a browser extension, your network, or a large data load in your workspace). The status page’s history goes back beyond current incidents, so you can still look up earlier windows after the fact.

Let me know if you need help navigating the status page!
